description.html: The Raised Toilet Seat adds 5 to 5.5 inches of height to the toilet seat to assist those with bending or sitting difficulties. The contoured seat features anti-slip rubber pads for stability and provides a wider, more comfortable seating area. Fits most standard and elongated toilets. Adds 5" to 5.5" of height to the toilet seat. The toilet seat elevator sits on top of the toilet to add an additional 5.5" of support for standing and sitting. Easy to install with no tools. The toilet elevator sits on the toilet with no tools or assembly required. This is perfect toilet assistance for elderly persons or anyone that wants a quick and easy solution. The contoured seat is wider for added comfort. The wider seat design adds even more comfort and flexibility for a wide range of users. Slip-resistant rubber pads for stability. The padded toilet seat offers more safety and less chance of falling. The elevated toilet seat is perfect for anyone that may struggle sitting up or down and pose a fall risk. 300 lbs of weight capacity. The toilet seas riser can hold up to 300 lbs making it very stable and able to hold large amounts of weight. Trust in Carex for all of your bathroom safety needs. The brand's line of products ranges from grab bars, transfer benches, shower chairs, wheelchairs, and other physical therapy products to aid in daily living or with various types of illnesses or injuries. Carex takes pride in providing a wide range of home health aides and safety products to improve the quality of life for those in need.

Seventy percent of home accidents occur in the bathroom making it the most dangerous room in the house for seniors. Carex bathroom safety products provide security while blending with your current bathroom decor. Use these products as a collection to create a bathroom with dignity, safety, and peace of mind. These items also serve as handicap accessories and bath aids for elderly people with limited mobility. Bathe with confidence and reclaim one of the most important rooms of your home with Carex bath safety products.

Osteoporosis is a painful condition that results in bone mass and density being reduced. This increases the risk of fractures and broken bones while reducing bone health. Our products empower those that may struggle with mobility and help them regain a long term healthy lifestyle while preventing further bone loss.
